concerns.location: spec.md:FR-001 vs US-3 Scenario 2 / idea 'Expected results'
concerns.text: Drift/under-reach: the idea's expected result explicitly requires showing 'negligible improvement on routine, single-step tasks' as a contrast, and US-3 Scenario 2 requires distinguishing 'complex multi-step' vs 'routine single-step' gains — but FR-001 excludes routine single-command tasks from the task set entirely. With routine tasks excluded, the routine-vs-complex comparison in US-3/SC-002 cannot be executed. Either include a routine-task control set or remove the routine-task claims.

SC-005 adds a top-k sensitivity sweep over {1,3,5} that the source idea did not request. It is a small robustness check, but it triples augmented-condition runs (24 tasks x 3 k-values) against the 6-hour CPU budget in SC-004/FR-002. Either justify it as essential to the research question or mark it explicitly as a secondary, budget-bounded analysis.
